I learned farming from my parents and I never went to school. My maize plot is very small, only 0.06 hectares, so I cannot buy a full bag of fertilizer from the cooperative — it costs too much and one bag is too much for my land. I will put cow manure on my plot because I have animals and my mother always did this. I will plant the local seed I saved from last harvest, and my family and I will do all the work with our hands because I have no cash to hire anyone or buy chemicals.
